You know every property by heart. The gate code at Riverside. Which back door sticks. The client who wants a heads-up text before anyone walks in. Years of it, all in your head.

The fix isn't a binder nobody reads. It's that every note your crew texts becomes searchable company knowledge. He texts his notes like he already does. The bot answers from those notes.

You built the business in your head. FieldNotes gets it out of your head.
